description.info: An AI-powered study tool for students at Kristiania. Ask questions, get explanations, and generate podcasts from your notes.

consent.suffix: you agree to our terms of service and privacy policy.

privacy.linkText: How do we use your data?
privacy.title: Privacy and data usage
privacy.intro: StudyBuddy is a study tool developed by students at Kristiania University College. Here is a brief overview of how we handle data.

sections.whatWeCollectText: We store chat conversations and settings tied to your user account. Login is handled via Microsoft Entra ID.
sections.howWeUseText: Data is only used to provide you with a personalized experience in the app. We do not sell data to third parties.
sections.microsoftText: Since you log in with your Microsoft account, Microsoft's own privacy statement also applies.
